2026_02_IND_KC.headline: Indianapolis faces Arrowhead with Kansas City’s protection and defensive interior under scrutiny
2026_02_IND_KC.paragraph1: Indianapolis arrives at Arrowhead without wide receiver Ashton Dulin, while Kansas City ruled out tackle Josh Simmons and defensive back Chamarri Conner. Chris Jones is questionable after a calf issue, and Patrick Mahomes finished the week as a full participant despite a knee listing. The Colts need Jonathan Taylor and Daniel Jones to keep the offense balanced and avoid predictable third-and-long situations; the Chiefs must protect Mahomes while maintaining enough interior disruption to prevent Indianapolis from dictating tempo.
2026_02_IND_KC.model_rationale: Kansas City’s protection and interior defensive health matter against an Indianapolis team that needs manageable downs, while the Colts must contain Mahomes when structure breaks down.
